body: Add an invariant check in `enforce_invariants` (invariants.rs) that validates `sum(egg_cohorts[*].count) == berried_females_count`. Currently `clamp_berried_to_adults` (line 42) and `retain(|c| c.count > 0)` (line 44) fix secondary invariants but never verify the primary one: that the per-cohort egg counts sum to the berried-female count. If these diverge (through save corruption, a future code change, or the legacy migration path at shrimp.rs:465-476 creating a cohort without matching counts), orphaned egg cohorts can silently resolve and produce phantom juveniles that inflate population. The fix is a one-line assertion or repair after line 44 in enforce_invariants.
